title: Advanced Darts Game with Fox Mascot
prompt:
Create a complete single-file HTML page with an advanced 3D darts game using Three.js. Follow ALL specifications precisely:

## Scene Setup
- Use Three.js with GLTFLoader from CDN (importmap or direct script tags).
- Create a perspective camera at position (0, 2, 6) looking toward (0, 2, 0).
- Add ambient light (intensity 0.5) and a directional light at (5, 10, 5) with intensity 1.0 and castShadow=true.
- Set renderer background to dark green (0x1a3d1a). Enable shadows.

## Dartboard
- Create a dartboard at position (0, 2, -5) facing the camera (a cylinder with radius 1.5, depth 0.1).
- The dartboard should have concentric ring zones scored as follows:
  - Bullseye (center, radius <= 0.15): 50 points
  - Inner Bull (radius <= 0.35): 25 points
  - Triple Ring (radius > 0.8 and radius <= 0.95): 3x the sector score
  - Double Ring (radius > 1.3 and radius <= 1.5): 2x the sector score
  - Inner Single (radius > 0.35 and radius <= 0.8): 1x sector score
  - Outer Single (radius > 0.95 and radius <= 1.3): 1x sector score
  - Miss (radius > 1.5): 0 points
- The board has 20 sectors (standard darts order: 20,1,18,4,13,6,10,15,2,17,3,19,7,16,8,11,14,9,12,5 clockwise from top).
- Visually represent the board with alternating colored segments (red/green for doubles/triples, black/white for singles).

## Fox Mascot
- Load 'Fox.glb' using GLTFLoader. Place the fox at position (3, 0, -3) with scale (0.02, 0.02, 0.02).
- The fox should have an idle animation playing by default (use AnimationMixer; play the first animation clip found).
- When the player scores a bullseye (50 points), trigger a celebration: the fox jumps up by 1 unit and spins 360 degrees over 1 second, then returns.
- When the player misses (0 points), the fox shakes its head (rotate Y back and forth ±15 degrees quickly).

## Darts (Projectiles)
- Create dart objects as a group: a thin cylinder (shaft) + cone (tip) + small fins. Color the shaft brown, tip silver, fins red.
- Each player gets 3 darts per round.
- The dart starts at position (0, 2, 5) when ready to throw.

## Throwing Mechanics
- Display a crosshair (HTML overlay, centered, 30x30px, thin cross lines) that follows mouse movement mapped to the board area.
- On mouse move, track the aim position on the board plane (x,y mapped to board coordinates).
- On LEFT CLICK, throw the dart: animate it from (0, 2, 5) to the aimed position on the board over 0.3 seconds with a slight parabolic arc (y rises by 0.3 then falls).
- Add a random accuracy offset: ±0.1 units in both x and y to simulate human error.
- After the dart lands, calculate the score based on where it hit and update the total.
- The dart should stick to the board (remain visible at the landing position).

## Game Rules (501 Style)
- Starting score: 501 for each player.
- Single player mode. The player must reduce their score from 501 to exactly 0.
- The last dart to win MUST land on a double or bullseye (double-out rule).
- If a throw would reduce the score below 0, or to exactly 1, or to 0 without a double/bullseye, that entire round's score is voided (bust) and the score reverts to what it was at the start of the round.
- Track rounds (each round = 3 darts).

## Power/Wind System
- Display a power meter on the left side of the screen (vertical bar, 200px tall, 30px wide).
- The power meter oscillates up and down continuously. Press SPACEBAR to lock the power.
- Power affects accuracy offset: low power (< 30%) adds extra ±0.2 offset; optimal power (40-60%) has no extra offset; high power (> 80%) adds ±0.15 offset.
- Display a wind indicator at the top: wind direction (left/right) and strength (0-5). Wind adds a horizontal offset of (windStrength * 0.05) in the wind direction. Wind changes randomly each round.

## HUD / UI
- Top-left: 'Score: 501' (updates as player scores), 'Round: 1', 'Darts Left: 3'.
- Top-right: 'Last Throw: --', 'Round Score: 0'.
- Bottom-center: 'Press SPACE to lock power, then CLICK to throw'.
- A 'New Game' button (DOM button, id='newGameBtn') that resets everything.
- A 'Clear Board' button (id='clearBoardBtn') that removes stuck darts and starts next round.
- Show a checkout suggestion when score <= 170 (text element id='checkoutHint').

## State Management
Expose window.__3D_STATE__ with these fields updated every frame:
- score: current remaining score (starts 501)
- round: current round number (starts 1)
- dartsLeft: darts remaining in current round (starts 3)
- dartsThrown: total darts thrown in the game
- lastThrowScore: points scored on last throw (0 if miss)
- lastThrowZone: string like 'T20', 'D16', 'S5', 'BULL', 'INNER_BULL', 'MISS'
- roundScore: accumulated score this round
- isBust: boolean, true if current round busted
- powerLocked: boolean, whether power is currently locked
- powerValue: current power meter value 0-100
- windDirection: 'left' or 'right'
- windStrength: number 0-5
- foxCelebrating: boolean, true during fox celebration animation
- foxShaking: boolean, true during fox head shake
- gameOver: boolean, true when score reaches exactly 0 with valid double-out
- dartsOnBoard: number of darts currently stuck on the board
- throwInProgress: boolean, true while dart is animating
- aimX: current crosshair x position mapped to board coords
- aimY: current crosshair y position mapped to board coords
- lastLandX: x coordinate where last dart landed on board
- lastLandY: y coordinate where last dart landed on board
- checkoutSuggestion: string with suggested checkout or empty string

## Animation Loop
- Update AnimationMixer for fox each frame.
- Update power meter oscillation (sine wave, period 2 seconds, range 0-100).
- Smooth dart flight animation when throwing.
- All state fields must be NaN-free at all times.
physics_constraints: Dart follows parabolic arc during throw. Random accuracy offset simulates human error. Power meter affects accuracy. Wind adds horizontal displacement. Score must never go below 0 (bust rule). Double-out required to win. All numerical state values must be finite and NaN-free.
